Knowledge check: Classic OSI stack bottom up = Physical Layer 1 through Network/Session on layer 5 is misremembered; the correct order from physical upwards is Physical(1)-Data Link(2)-Network(3)-Transport(4)-Session(5)-Presentation(6)-Application(7).
